alert_news.title: HAL and Samtel inaugurate facility of India's first public-private defence avionics JV in Gurugram
bullets: India’s first public‑private defence avionics joint‑venture facility, SHDS, opened at Udyog Vihar, Phase IV, Gurugram.
The plant will indigenously design, qualify and serially produce multifunction displays (MFDs) for fighter aircraft such as the Su‑30 MKI, ALH and LCH.
Joint venture between Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) and Samtel Avionics; marks the first such JV in India’s defence‑avionics sector.

alert_news.title: India’s First Underground Coal Gasification Project in Kasta
bullets: India’s first underground coal-to-gasification pilot project, located in Kasta block (Kasta West) spanning Jharkhand and West Bengal, managed by Eastern Coalfields Limited under Coal India Limited.
Funded by the CIL R&D Board, the two‑year, two‑phase program aims to establish pilot‑scale in‑situ syngas production and demonstrate technical feasibility.
Marks a milestone in India’s pursuit of cleaner coal utilization technologies, becoming the country’s premier underground coal gasification initiative.

alert_news.title: India's First Bullet Train Corridor Gains Momentum As 74 Km Of Piers Ready For Viaduct ...
bullets: India’s first bullet train corridor: a 135.45‑km elevated stretch in Maharashtra (Thane‑Palghar) part of the Mumbai‑Ahmedabad High Speed Rail corridor, built by National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited (NHSRCL).
74 km of piers completed and ready for viaduct girders; 3 of 7 mountain tunnels have achieved breakthrough; 36 bridges and crossings, including 12 steel bridges over major railway lines.
Project includes 124.027 km of viaducts and bridges, with major river bridges over the Ulhas, Vaitarna, and Jagani rivers.

alert_news.title: Mumbai-Ahmedabad Bullet train project construction work making rapid progress: NHSRCL - ET Infra
bullets: India’s first bullet train corridor: a 135.45‑km elevated stretch in Maharashtra (Thane‑Palghar) part of the Mumbai‑Ahmedabad High Speed Rail corridor, executed by National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited (NHSRCL).
74 km of piers completed and ready for viaduct girders; 3 of 7 mountain tunnels have achieved breakthrough; 36 bridges and crossings, including 12 steel bridges over major railway lines.
Construction supported by 9 casting yards, 7 full‑span launching gantries, and 8 SBS launching gantries, with major river bridges over the Ulhas, Vaitarna, and Jagani rivers.

alert_news.title: Chhattisgarh launches India's first official state hockey league
bullets: India’s first official state-level hockey league, the Chhattisgarh Hockey League (CHL), inaugurated in Raipur at the Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel International Hockey Stadium under Hockey India and the Sports and Youth Welfare Department of Chhattisgarh.
The league features six franchise teams, runs from 21 Oct to 1 Nov 2026, and follows a round‑robin format with semifinals and a final.

alert_news.title: Uttarakhand to set up India's first Agniveer Employment Cell for jobs, schemes
bullets: India's first dedicated Agniveer Employment Cell, announced by the Uttarakhand state government, to link former Agniveers with government jobs, schemes and self‑employment opportunities
Located in Uttarakhand; provides 10% reservation, age relaxation and priority recruitment for ex‑servicemen, marking the inaugural employment‑transition cell for Agniveers in the country

alert_news.title: India’s first Olympic skeet shooter
bullets: First Indian skeet shooter to qualify for the Olympics, representing India at Rio 2016 and Tokyo 2020
First Indian skeet shooter to win an ISSF World Cup medal (silver 2016) and gold (2022)

alert_news.title: India’s first construction technology expo, conference and awards platform
bullets: India’s first construction technology expo, conference and awards platform – The ConTech Show 2026, held at Bombay Exhibition Centre, Mumbai
Integrated architects, builders, developers, startups, banks and technology companies to promote adoption of AI, BIM, robotics and digital twins in construction

alert_news.title: First Indian woman to win COSPAR medal
bullets: First Indian woman to receive the COSPAR Vikram Sarabhai Medal, awarded by COSPAR and ISRO at the 46th COSPAR Scientific Assembly, Florence, Italy
The medal honors outstanding contributions to space research; she is the third woman overall to receive it

alert_news.title: Made in Amethi: India's first 100% indigenous AK-203 Sher is ready for its biggest test
bullets: India's first fully indigenised AK-203 "Sher" assault rifle, manufactured at the IRRPL Korwa facility in Amethi, Uttar Pradesh, under the Ministry of Defence.
All components and raw materials sourced domestically; production target of 150,000 rifles per year with a prototype every 100 seconds, marking a historic self‑reliance milestone.

alert_news.title: India’s First Solar-Powered ‘Algae Trees’ Installed In Bhopal
bullets: India's first solar-powered algae trees installed in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh
Algae trees use solar energy to produce biofuel and purify water
Installed by local authorities as part of green initiative

alert_news.title: India’s First 100% Indigenous AK-203 Sher Assault Rifle
bullets: India's first fully indigenous AK-203 Sher assault rifle manufactured at IRRPL's Korwa facility in Amethi
All components sourced domestically, marking end-to-end indigenisation
Prototype completed firing tests, ready for Indian Army trials

alert_news.title: India's first successful landing on the Moon's south polar region by Chandrayaan‑3
bullets: India's first successful lunar landing on the Moon's south polar region by ISRO's Chandrayaan‑3 Vikram Lander on 23 August 2023
Landing site named Shiv Shakti; marks India's inaugural landing on the Moon's south polar region

alert_news.title: India Plans Bharatiya Antariksha Station by 2035
bullets: India’s first space station, Bharatiya Antariksh Station (BAS), planned by ISRO, 52‑tonne, low‑Earth orbit 400‑450 km, 5 modules.
First module BAS‑01 approved by the Union Cabinet, cost ₹1,763 crore, development scheduled 2025‑2028.
BAS is part of the Gaganyaan human spaceflight programme, designed to support a crew of 3‑4 astronauts for 3‑6 months.

alert_news.title: India Approves First Module of Bharatiya Antariksha Station – India's First Space Station
bullets: India’s first space station, Bharatiya Antariksha Station (BAS), approved by the Union Cabinet; first module BAS‑01, 52‑tonne, 400‑450 km low‑Earth orbit.
Estimated cost ₹1,763 crore, five modules planned, crew of 3‑4 astronauts for 3‑6 month stays, part of ISRO’s Gaganyaan human‑spaceflight programme.

alert_news.title: India's first 100% indigenised AK-203 'Sher' rifle made, test‑fired at factory in UP's Amethi
bullets: India’s first 100% indigenised AK‑203 ‘Sher’ rifle manufactured and test‑fired at Indo‑Russian Rifles Private Limited (IRRPL) factory in Amethi, Uttar Pradesh.
All components sourced from Indian industry under a ₹5,200 crore contract to supply 6,01,427 rifles to the Indian Army by 2032.

alert_news.title: VP Radhakrishnan to launch India’s first non‑GMO high‑expansion popcorn maize hybrid seed
bullets: India’s first non‑GMO high‑expansion popcorn maize hybrid seed launched by Vice President CP Radhakrishnan in Musunuru village, Eluru district, Andhra Pradesh.
The seed is a hybrid variety designed for popcorn production, marking the first non‑GMO high‑expansion maize variety released in India.

alert_news.title: AssamSAT moves closer to implementation as partner selection enters final stage
bullets: AssamSAT, India’s first state‑led Earth Observation satellite system, is being implemented under the DBLOTT (Design, Build, Launch, Operate, Train and Transfer) model by the Assam government.
The satellite system will provide Earth observation data for evidence‑based governance and development planning across the state.

alert_news.title: India's first private rocket launch
bullets: Skyroot Aerospace launched India's first private rocket on 18 July 2026, deploying satellites into orbit.
Skyroot, India's first space‑tech unicorn, achieved this milestone.

alert_news.title: India's First 21 CuM Electric Shovel Commissioned in Chhattisgarh by SECL - Indian PSU
bullets: India’s first 21 CuM capacity electro‑hydraulic face shovel commissioned at SECL’s Gevra Mega Project, Korba, Chhattisgarh.
Machine equipped with 360° camera, operator fatigue monitoring, integrated Fleet Management System; annual production capacity ~5.31 million cubic metres.

alert_news.title: India’s First Make-in-India 1‑MW Green Hydrogen Plant at Kandla
bullets: India’s first Make‑in‑India 1‑MW green hydrogen plant located at Kandla port, built by Deendayal Port Authority (DPA) Kandla
1‑MW capacity, inaugurated during the Kandla Green Hydrogen Conclave 2026 as part of India’s green maritime and energy transition

alert_news.title: India’s First Fully Integrated Olympic-Standard Archery Centre in Rural India
bullets: India’s first fully integrated Olympic‑standard archery centre in a rural setting, located in Kanhauli, Eastern Uttar Pradesh, developed by Axis Bank and Sanjeeva Singh Archery Institute Trust (SSAIT)

Facility features Olympic‑standard indoor and outdoor ranges, competition‑grade infrastructure, advanced simulation capabilities, and residential facilities to create a direct pathway from grassroots talent identification to elite international competition

alert_news.title: India’s First Cable‑Stayed Railway Bridge – Anji Khad Bridge
bullets: First cable‑stayed railway bridge in India, located at Anji Khad Bridge on the Katra‑Banihal section of the Udhampur‑Srinagar‑Baramulla Railway Link
Bridge spans 1,200 m and was inaugurated in 2024 as part of the USBRL project, enhancing connectivity across the Pir Panjal range

alert_news.title: Paradip Port’s First Piped‑Gas Residential Township
bullets: First major Indian port to supply piped natural gas to its residential township, connecting 546 quarters in Madhuban at Paradip Port
Project cost ₹20 crore, enabled by the Urja Ganga pipeline and Dhamra LNG Terminal, inaugurated in 2026 under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways

alert_news.title: India's First Large-Scale Biopolymer Plant Set for October Launch
bullets: India’s first large‑scale biopolymer plant at Balrampur Chini Mills’ Kumbhi sugar unit, Gola Gokarannath, Lakhimpur Kheri district, Uttar Pradesh, slated for commissioning in October 2026.
Project cost ₹3,080 crore; plant will convert locally grown sugarcane into polylactic acid (PLA) using a zero‑liquid‑discharge system.
Facility will manufacture biodegradable plates, cups and bags that decompose within 3–6 months.

alert_news.title: DPA Kandla hosts 2026 Green Hydrogen Conclave - The News Mill
bullets: India’s first Make‑in‑India 1‑MW green hydrogen plant located at DPA Kandla, Gandhidham, Gujarat.
Plant showcased during the Kandla Green Hydrogen Conclave 2026, demonstrating domestic green‑hydrogen production capability.
Milestone marks India’s entry into the green‑hydrogen economy, supporting maritime decarbonisation.

alert_news.title: Fairmont Mumbai and Le Florence India Hosted India's First Longevity Summit 2026 with AIWO
bullets: India’s first Longevity Summit 2026 convened at Fairmont Mumbai, Maharashtra, drawing over 1,000 delegates.
Summit focused on science, healthcare, wellness, technology and conscious living, exploring health‑span extension and longevity research.
Event marked a national milestone in India’s emerging longevity and wellness ecosystem.

alert_news.title: India's first large‑scale sugarcane‑based biopolymer plant set for commissioning in Uttar Pradesh
bullets: India's first industrial‑scale sugarcane‑derived PLA biopolymer plant, located at Kumbhi, Lakhimpur Kheri, Uttar Pradesh, built by Balrampur Chini Mills Ltd.
Planned annual capacity of 80,000 tonnes, powered entirely by renewable energy; project cost Rs 2,850 crore, commissioning expected October 2026

alert_news.title: India secures its first BWF World Championships medal – women's doubles bronze
bullets: India's first ever medal at the Badminton World Federation (BWF) World Championships, won by the women's doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand in 2026.
Bronze medal clinched at the tournament held in New Delhi's Indira Gandhi Arena, marking the country's inaugural podium finish at the BWF Worlds

alert_news.title: India’s First State Transport Concession Passengers Use NCMC Smartcards
bullets: First nationwide deployment of National Common Mobility Card (NCMC) for state transport concession passengers, covering 16,000 villages in Maharashtra via MSRTC.
More than 1 crore NCMC RuPay smartcards issued in five months, at a pace of ~66,000 cards per day (~46 per minute), replacing paper concession passes.

alert_news.title: India's First State Transport Concessional Passengers Use National Common Mobility Card
bullets: First use of NCMC RuPay smartcards for state transport concession passengers across Maharashtra, replacing paper passes
1 crore+ cards issued in five months – 66,000 per day, 46 per minute – by Ebix, NSDL Payments Bank and MSRTC
Partnership enables offline validation of concession entitlements on bus ticketing machines

alert_news.title: India's First Mini Electric Passenger Aircraft Series Under Development by AlphaX Aerospace
bullets: SkyRover, India's first mini electric passenger aircraft series, designed for VTOL with 800 km range and 300–400 km/h cruise speed
Developed by Karnataka startup AlphaX Aerospace to connect Tier‑2/3 cities to Tier‑1 hubs without congested airports
Platform incorporates modular airframe (AeroCore), GlideCore, and FlightCore technologies for safety and performance

alert_news.title: India's First Judicial Framework on Copyright and Generative AI Established by Delhi High Court
bullets: Delhi High Court delivered India's first judicial framework on copyright issues involving generative AI in ANI Media Pvt. Ltd. v. Open AI OpCo LLC
Judgment clarified scope of Section 52(1)(a) and territorial jurisdiction for AI developers operating overseas
Set a precedent for AI‑generated content and copyright infringement in India

alert_news.title: India’s First Immersive Language Museum Opens in Kolkata
bullets: India’s first immersive language museum, Shabdalok, located at Belvedere House, Kolkata, opened by the National Library.
The museum houses nine galleries that allow visitors to smell, touch, and listen to the evolution of words across India’s 22 constitutionally recognized languages.

alert_news.title: India's First Liquid‑Cooled Power Modules for EV Chargers Produced by Exicom
bullets: India’s first liquid‑cooled AC and DC power modules for electric‑vehicle chargers are manufactured by Exicom Tele‑Systems at its Hyderabad plant.
The modules, which keep components about 10 °C cooler than conventional air‑cooled units, will power Tritium’s DC‑FLEX and TRI‑FLEX chargers for North American and European markets.

alert_news.title: Exicom's EV Charger Breakthrough: India's First Liquid‑Cooled Power Modules Hit Production
bullets: India’s first liquid‑cooled AC and DC power modules for EV chargers are manufactured by Exicom Tele‑Systems at its Hyderabad plant.
The modules lower component temperature by ~10 °C compared to air‑cooled systems and are the first Indian production for international EV charging markets.
Initial production will supply Tritium’s DC‑FLEX and TRI‑FLEX ultra‑fast chargers for North American and European markets.

alert_news.title: Mumbai-Ahmedabad Bullet Train: India's First High-Speed Rail Corridor Advances With 359 ...
bullets: India's first high-speed rail corridor, 508 km Mumbai–Ahmedabad, implemented by National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited (NHSRCL)
Expected operational by 2029, 12 stations, travel time 1 hour 58 minutes between Mumbai and Ahmedabad

alert_news.title: India's FIRST 14-metre acoustic-transparent 4K LED cinema screen opens in Kochi
bullets: India's first 14‑metre acoustic‑transparent Direct View 4K HDR LED cinema screen installed at Magic Frames, Kakkanad, Kochi
Screen measures 14 m × 6 m, 4K HDR, 3.91 mm pixel pitch, acoustic‑transparent architecture allows speakers behind the display

alert_news.title: Centre clears 31 more ECMS projects; approved investment crosses Rs 69,500 crore
bullets: India’s first domestic manufacturing of critical electronic components—filters, coils, speakers, acetylene black and electrolyte additives—under the Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme (ECMS).
ECMS now has 106 approved projects with a cumulative investment of over Rs 69,500 crore, 38 plants already operational and 16 in advanced construction stages.

alert_news.title: India's First Guide to Grasslands and Open Natural Ecosystems
bullets: India launched its first-ever Guide to Grasslands and Other Open Natural Ecosystems (ONEs) on 17 August 2026 during COP17 in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia.

The guide is a national publication under the Wildlife Protection Act, 1972, Environment Protection Act, 1986, and National Biodiversity Action Plan, aiming to support land restoration, biodiversity conservation, and climate resilience.
It provides a comprehensive framework for managing grassland ecosystems, promoting sustainable grazing, and enhancing carbon sequestration across India.

alert_news.title: Important Indian Space Missions and Collaborations with Foreign Agencies - GKToday
bullets: Chandrayaan‑1, launched on 22 October 2008 aboard PSLV‑C11, was India’s first lunar probe carrying 11 scientific instruments including the Moon Mineralogy Mapper.
The mission confirmed the presence of water molecules on the lunar surface and established India as a pioneer in lunar exploration.
Chandrayaan‑1 laid the foundation for India’s subsequent planetary missions, including Chandrayaan‑2 and Chandrayaan‑3.

alert_news.title: India’s First Lunar Probe Chandrayaan‑1 and First Dedicated Multi‑Wavelength Space Observatory AstroSat
bullets: Chandrayaan‑1, launched 2008 on PSLV‑C11, was India’s first lunar probe carrying 11 instruments including NASA and ESA payloads
AstroSat, launched 2015 on PSLV‑C30, is India’s first dedicated multi‑wavelength space observatory monitoring UV, optical, and X‑ray bands

alert_news.title: India's First Domestic Manufacturing of Critical Electronic Components Approved Under ECMS
bullets: India's first domestic manufacturing of critical electronic components—filters, coils, speakers, acetylene black, electrolyte additives—approved under the Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme (ECMS) by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY).
The scheme now has 106 cleared proposals, with 31 new projects approved, pushing cumulative approved investment beyond Rs 69,500 crore and generating around 75,000 direct jobs.

Production capacities for key components such as anode material (110% of demand), optical transceiver‑SFP (350%), and relays (200%) have already surpassed domestic demand, marking a milestone in self‑reliance.

alert_news.title: India's first Vande Bharat sleeper depot takes shape in Jodhpur
bullets: India’s first maintenance depot dedicated to Vande Bharat sleeper trains, located in Jodhpur, built by Indian Railways under a joint venture with a Russian technology partner
First phase cost approximately Rs 140 crore, with a second phase planned at Rs 100 crore; depot will serve the North‑Western region covering Delhi, Jaipur, Ajmer, Barmer, and Ahmedabad routes

alert_news.title: India’s First Virtual Zoo – 14D Immersive Experience
bullets: India’s first virtual zoo, a 14D immersive experience, located at Kamala Nehru Prani Sangrahalaya, Indore, Madhya Pradesh.
Built by Indore Municipal Corporation under a PPP model, covering 8,000 sq ft and costing ₹4.6 crore.
Features a 14D cinema theatre with waterproof screen, digital jungle safari, 3D dome, and sensory effects (water, wind, fog, smells, moving seats).

alert_news.title: Karnataka to launch AI education from Class 6 and establish India's first government-owned AI university
bullets: Karnataka will introduce AI education from Class 6 through AI Akshara Abhiyana and Coding Gurukula programmes.
The state is also establishing India's first government-owned AI university in Bengaluru.
AI certificate courses are slated to launch in January 2027, with AI hubs planned across Karnataka.

alert_news.title: India’s First Government Hospital with AI‑Based Pneumatic Tube System – Dr Marri Chenna Reddy TIMS
bullets: India’s first government hospital to install an AI‑based pneumatic tube system, at Dr Marri Chenna Reddy TIMS, Telangana.
Hospital spans 22.6 acres, houses 1,082 beds (300 ICU), 31 major OT, 6 minor OT and advanced diagnostic labs.
AI pneumatic tube transports blood samples and medical reports between wards, labs and pharmacy in 1–2 minutes.

alert_news.title: India's first virtual zoo opens in Indore with 14‑D cinema and virtual jungle safari facilities
bullets: India’s first virtual zoo inaugurated at Kamala Nehru Prani Sangrahalaya, Indore, Madhya Pradesh.
Developed under a PPP model at a cost of ₹4.5 crore, it houses a 14‑D cinema, a 3‑D dome theatre and a digital jungle safari.
The 8,000‑sq‑ft facility opened to the public on 17 August 2026.

alert_news.title: Indore Gets India's First Virtual Zoo
bullets: India’s first virtual zoo established at the Kamala Nehru Prani Sangrahalaya, Indore, Madhya Pradesh.
The 8,000‑sq‑ft complex, built under a Public‑Private Partnership, cost ₹4.5 crore and features a 14‑D cinema, 3‑D dome theatre and a digital jungle safari.
It opened on 17 August 2026, offering immersive wildlife experiences through advanced projection and sensory effects.

alert_news.title: Indias First Sports AI Center Launches at LNIPE Gwalior
bullets: India’s first Sports AI Centre inaugurated at Lakshmibai National Institute of Physical Education (LNIPE), Gwalior.
The centre will use AI to analyse athletes’ physique, movement and performance for early talent identification and training optimisation.
It is part of the Sports Education Technology Upgradation initiative and is expected to be fully operational by November 2026.

alert_news.title: Karnataka Introduces QR Code‑Based Food Safety Complaint System – First in India
bullets: Karnataka becomes the first Indian state to deploy QR codes outside hotels and pharmacies for real‑time food safety complaints.
The system allows citizens to scan a code and file complaints directly; 60 hotels have already received notices.

alert_news.title: India's 1st Virtual Zoo Lets You Experience The Jungle In 14D Without Leaving Your Seat
bullets: India’s first virtual zoo located in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, built by Indore Municipal Corporation under a PPP model at a cost of ₹4.6 crore.

The 8,000‑sq‑ft facility houses a 14D cinema theatre with a waterproof screen imported from South Korea, offering 14 real‑life effects such as water sprays, wind blasts, fog, bubbles, smells and moving seats.

alert_news.title: CM Revanth Reddy to inaugurate AI-equipped Dr Marri Chenna Reddy TIMS today
bullets: India’s first government hospital to install an AI‑based pneumatic tube system, located at Dr Marri Chenna Reddy TIMS in Telangana and built by the state government.

The system moves blood samples and medical reports between wards, labs and pharmacy in 1–2 minutes; the hospital spans 22.6 acres with 1,082 beds, 300 ICU beds, 31 major and 6 minor operation theatres.

alert_news.title: How Karnataka will create 1 lakh new jobs - HR Katha
bullets: Bengaluru will host India’s first government‑owned AI university, part of Karnataka’s AI education initiative announced by the state government.
The university, to be established under the state’s Udyoga Sankalpa and Udyoga Nidhi schemes, aims to advance AI research and education across the country.

alert_news.title: Karnataka CM Announces AI Akshara Abhiyana, Coding Gurukula for School Students from Class 6
bullets: India's first government-owned AI University to be established in Bengaluru, Karnataka.
The university will be set up by the state government, marking the first of its kind in India.

alert_news.title: India's First Lunar Landing: Chandrayaan-3 Successfully Lands Vikram Lander on Moon
bullets: India's first lunar landing was achieved by Chandrayaan-3 in 2023, with the successful landing of the Vikram lander and deployment of the Pragyan rover near the lunar south polar region.
This marked a historic achievement, making India the fourth country to achieve a lunar landing after the United States, Russia, and China.
The Chandrayaan-3 mission demonstrated India's capability to explore and operate in space, a significant milestone in the country's space journey.

alert_news.title: India's First Satellite: Aryabhata Launched in 1975
bullets: India's first satellite, Aryabhata, was launched on April 19, 1975, from the Volgograd Launch Station (Kapustin Yar) in the Soviet Union using a Kosmos-3M launch vehicle.
Aryabhata marked the beginning of India's journey towards developing its own expertise in spacecraft and space science.
The satellite was a significant milestone in India's space programme, paving the way for the development of indigenous launch vehicles and satellites.

alert_news.title: India's First AI-Powered Household-Level Skill Census Model
bullets: India's first AI-powered, household-level skill census model was conducted in H/West ward of Mumbai Suburban district, covering Bandra West, Khar West, and Santacruz West.
This model aims to understand the real employment potential of urban population and bridge the gap between skills and employment through certification and women's workforce participation.
The survey is expected to create Maharashtra's blueprint for future livelihood intelligence.

alert_news.title: India's First Government-Owned AI University to be Established in Bengaluru
bullets: India's first government-owned AI university to be established in Bengaluru, Karnataka, marking a significant milestone in the country's AI education sector.

The university will be a pioneering institution in India, focusing on artificial intelligence education and research, and will play a crucial role in preparing the country's youth for the emerging technological era.
The establishment of this university is a testament to the government's commitment to promoting AI education and innovation in the country.

alert_news.title: India's First 440 Space Technology Startups Registered
bullets: India has around 440 space technology startups registered, as per the DPIIT Start-up India Portal.
IN-SPACe has granted 113 authorisations to 52 Non-Government Entities (NGEs) for various space activities, out of which 18 are start-ups.
Private investment in India's space sector surged nearly six-fold, climbing from USD 100.5 million in 2021-22 to USD 618.5 million by March 31, 2026.

alert_news.title: India's First Vande Bharat Freight Train Clocks 130 kmph in Trial
bullets: India's first Vande Bharat freight train was tested at 130 kmph on the Kota-Rohal Khurd section of West Central Railway.

The train was developed by Chennai-based Integral Coach Factory and is equipped with advanced propulsion and braking systems, roller floor system, automatic wide sliding doors, temperature-controlled facilities, CCTV surveillance, and fire detection systems.
The trial was conducted as part of technical testing by teams from Research Designs and Standards Organisation (RDSO) and Integral Coach Factory (ICF) to assess the train's performance at high speed.

alert_news.title: India's First Vande Bharat Freight Train Completes High-Speed Safety And Braking Trials
bullets: India's first Vande Bharat freight train, manufactured at Chennai's Integral Coach Factory, has a maximum operational speed of 160 kmph and a total payload capacity of 395 tonnes.

The 16-coach prototype features modern safety features including fire detection systems, CCTV surveillance, and the Indian Railways' automated anti-collision system KAVACH, with automatic door locking at 5 kmph and secured doors required for movement.
The high-speed freight service is expected to benefit sectors such as e-commerce, pharmaceuticals, agriculture, and express logistics, with faster deliveries critical for business operations.

alert_news.title: India's First Geothermal Power Project in an Island Region
bullets: India's first geothermal power project in an island region to be developed in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, with the Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) Ltd inviting Expressions of Interest (EoIs) from agencies to undertake geothermal resource assessment, exploration, and potential power plant development.
The project aims to reduce the islands' dependence on diesel imports and provide indigenous, weather-independent baseload renewable power, improving long-term energy security for the islands.

The proposed programme will begin with geological, geophysical, and geochemical investigations, followed by exploratory drilling, resource validation, and subject to successful resource confirmation, the development of a geothermal power plant.

alert_news.title: Uttar Pradesh: Parichha Weir Gets ICID Heritage Recognition
bullets: Parichha Weir in Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh, becomes India's first World Heritage Irrigation Structure (WHIS) designated by the International Commission on Irrigation and Drainage (ICID).
The 140-year-old Parichha Weir is a rubble-stone masonry structure stretching 1,174 metres and standing 16.8 metres above the riverbed, with a reservoir capacity of 2,400 million cubic feet.
The Betwa Canal system associated with the weir extends about 2,654 km and irrigates 4,28,360 hectares across five districts in Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh.

alert_news.title: Kerala Police launches 'My Police Station' initiative with dedicated help desks
bullets: Kerala Police launches 'My Police Station' initiative with dedicated complaint, women's, children's, senior citizens', transgender, persons with disabilities, cybercrime, and legal-aid help desks.
Police stations will have assistance for applications, online services, RTI-related information, and obtaining FIR copies.
Appointment of young Sub-Inspectors as Station House Officers, with 63 women Sub-Inspectors taking charge as SHOs, is a major change.

alert_news.title: India's First University-led National Space Technology Conclave
bullets: India's first university-led National Space Technology Conclave (NSTC) 2026 is being organized by Chandigarh University's Kalpana Chawla Centre for Research in Space Science and Technology (KCC) in collaboration with ISRO and IIST.

The conclave will focus on the theme 'Emerging Space Technologies for India's Future Space Missions' and will feature 30 distinguished scientists, mission leaders, and technologists from ISRO, IIST, IN-SPACe, NSIL, and URSC, along with 10 CEOs and senior leaders from leading Indian space industries and start-ups.

The conclave will provide a platform for students to engage with space experts and will feature five roundtables and space technology demonstrations, facilitating discussions on the technologies shaping India's next phase of space exploration and human spaceflight.

alert_news.title: Punjab Police's Sadak Surakhya Force to become India's first 3D policing model
bullets: Punjab Police's Sadak Surakhya Force (SSF) will become India's first 3D policing model by integrating drones, satellite imagery, and artificial intelligence (AI) powered predictive systems.
The 3D policing model will create real-time situational awareness, anticipate risks, and support faster police response, making overall traffic and road safety policing more versatile.

The SSF will extend its coverage from 5,500 km to 6,000 km of state roads and aims to build an integrated road safety ecosystem combining satellite data, AI, drones, and geospatial technologies by 2047.

alert_news.title: Prakriti Gyan Dham: India's First Eco-Educational Hub
bullets: Prakriti Gyan Dham is India's first-of-its-kind eco-educational hub, an interactive, open-air facility located at Maharishi Parashar Bioresource Centre (MPBC) in Banthra, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.

Developed by CSIR-National Botanical Research Institute (CSIR-NBRI), it aims to extend scientific research beyond institutional laboratory walls into society, fostering experiential environmental education and preserving botanical-cultural heritage.

Key features include the PAaVan Path (Heritage Trail), Indian Heritage Garden with Interactive QR Systems, The Bamboosteum, Conservation Enclaves (Vibhav & Bhairav), and Lab-to-Society Technology Transfer.

alert_news.title: India's First Private Orbital Rocket Developed by Skyroot Aerospace
bullets: India's first privately developed orbital rocket, Vikram-1, was developed by Skyroot Aerospace, a Hyderabad-based company.

The rocket was designed and developed by a team of 14 Keralite engineers, including Nirmal Nelson, Ajith Kumar S, Dr Binet Monachan, Ajin Ghosh K, Ranjith Ravi, Lint C Thomas, Anjali Ashokan, Vaisakh V, Ramshij M, Anantha Krishnan, Vishnu M K, Sreenath S, Rahul Ramesh, and Alexis J Neerakkal.

alert_news.title: India's First Generative-AI Powered Government e-Marketplace (GeMAI)
bullets: India's first generative-AI powered government e-marketplace (GeMAI) launched by GeM in May 2025.
GeMAI aims to enable intelligent procurement through AI technology, building on GeM's existing tech infrastructure.
GeM is a government e-marketplace that facilitates procurement of goods and services for the Indian government.

alert_news.title: V.O.C. Port Becomes India's First Scope-2 Emission-Free Major Port
bullets: V.O.C. Port in Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu, became India's first major port to achieve Scope-2 Emission-Free status on 10 August 2026.
The port secured ISO 50001:2018 certification for its Energy Management System, with renewable energy meeting 93.89% of its total electricity consumption in the 2025-26 financial year.
V.O.C. Port has active green infrastructure including 7.04 MW of solar capacity and 2 MW of wind capacity, with plans for additional renewable energy projects.

alert_news.title: India's First AI Generation: Gen Z
bullets: India's first generation to step into higher education and the workplace in the age of AI is Gen Z.
Gen Z is growing up in an era where AI is evolving at a remarkable speed, and they are the first to begin their professional journey alongside AI.
India's demographic dividend will remain a statistic unless it is transformed into an economic and an AI dividend, which will depend on whether its Gen Z are equipped to thrive in an AI-driven world.

alert_news.title: India's First Experimental Remote Sensing Satellites: Bhaskara-I and Bhaskara-II
bullets: Bhaskara-I and Bhaskara-II (1979-1981) were India's first experimental remote sensing satellites launched by Soviet intercosmos rockets.
These satellites carried TV cameras and Microwave Radiometers (SAMIR) to collect preliminary data on hydrology, forestry, and oceanography.
Bhaskara-I and Bhaskara-II marked the beginning of India's remote sensing capabilities and paved the way for future operational constellations.
